fact: British International Investment (BII, UK development finance institution) made a US$40M equity investment in IHS Zambia Limited, an independent telecoms tower operator with over 1,700 towers in Zambia, in October 2015; exited by March 2021.

British International Investment (BII, UK development finance institution) made a second US$25.5M equity investment in IHS Zambia Limited, a tower operator in Zambia, in July 2017; exited by March 2021.

Acumen's Hardest-to-Reach Catalyze initiative closed a US$5M equity investment in Sun King's Zambia subsidiary, a pay-as-you-go solar company whose customers repay by mobile money; the document gives no signing date, so its publication date of 2026-09-25 is used.

fact: Lupiya, a Zambian digital lender (financier and recipient the same company, home-grown), said on its tenth anniversary that it will itself put a further K500 million into loans to Zambian small businesses, farmers, traders and women entrepreneurs over the next decade.
